data.one_liner: A simple numeric keyboard widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a numeric keyboard widget that can be embedded in your app layout. It supports custom text colors, left and right custom action buttons with icons, and a tap callback to handle numeric inputs.
use_when: You need a custom in-app numeric keypad for entering PINs or amounts
You want to avoid using the system software keyboard for specific numeric inputs
avoid_when: You require a complex, multi-language system keyboard replacement
You need advanced input masking out-of-the-box
weaknesses: No built-in input formatting or masking
